prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1265; do not mention it.)
text: This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already spoken with our client, please let us know so we can address it. We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits applicable to the policy in force at the time of the accident, along with a certified copy of the declarations page. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including photographs, vehicle damage appraisals, recorded statements, claim file notes, telematics or dashcam data, and any repair records for both vehicles. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained. We look forward to your prompt response so that our client's claim can be evaluated fairly and without unnecessary delay.
